mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_workorder_cancellation WHERE workorder_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document WHERE source_workorder_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_receipt WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_quality_treatment WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_quality_release WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_warehouse_acceptance WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_execution_completion WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_material_issue_input WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action WHERE execution_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document WHERE source_execution_id=#{id})

SELECT COUNT(e.id) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status != #{completed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS unfinished_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = #{completed} AND c.execution_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS missing_completion_count FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.workorder_id=w.id AND e.status != #{cancelled} LEFT JOIN (SELECT execution_id FROM mes_execution_completion GROUP BY execution_id) c ON c.execution_id=e.id WHERE w.id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(d.id) FROM wm_stock_document d LEFT JOIN mes_material_issue_input f ON f.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id=d.source_execution_id AND e.workorder_id=d.source_workorder_id WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{id} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted} AND (d.source_execution_id IS NOT NULL OR d.source_request_json IS NOT NULL OR f.id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.document_id=d.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.document_id=d.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action r WHERE r.reference_action_id=l.stock_action_id AND r.action_type=#{enumReversal}))) AND (f.id IS NULL OR f.input_kind!=#{enumProductionInput} OR f.confirmed_at IS NULL OR f.stock_applied!=TRUE OR f.execution_id!=d.source_execution_id OR e.id IS NULL OR e.status!=#{enumFullyReceived})

SELECT r.id,r.code,r.name,r.version,r.status,r.description,r.external_id,r.source_version,r.revision,r.published_at FROM routing r JOIN routing_product p ON p.routing_id=r.id JOIN material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.id=#{productId} AND m.status=#{enabledStatus} AND r.status=#{publishedStatus} AND (r.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR r.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT w.id AS workorder_id,w.planned_qty, COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0) AS allocated_target_qty, w.planned_qty-COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0) AS remaining_target_qty, CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0)-w.planned_qty,0) AS DECIMAL(65,6)) AS excess_target_qty, COUNT(e.id) AS execution_count FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.workorder_id=w.id AND e.status!=#{cancelled} WHERE w.id IN #{id} GROUP BY w.id,w.planned_qty

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_document d WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status!=#{enumCancelled} AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.document_id=d.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.document_id=d.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action r WHERE r.reference_action_id=l.stock_action_id AND r.action_type=#{enumReversal})))
